description:
FOUND s492a (Opus, 2026-09-20) while measuring #1998 (the circular-`use`
import fix).  With #1998 fixed, IO::Socket, IO::Socket::INET, IO::Socket::UNIX
and HTTP::Tiny all LOAD; IPC::Cmd still does not, and the cause is unrelated
to circularity.  PRE-EXISTING on main 268d7e00.

REPRODUCER (probed vs perl 5.40.3; scratch/s492a/probes/m4-modload.pl in the
s492a worktree):
  use IPC::Cmd ();            perl: loads
  ./runpcl <same>             PCL:  FAIL
     IO::Seekable::getpos missing at .../lib/5.40.3/FileHandle.pm line 60

FileHandle.pm line 60 is
    Exporter::export(q(IO::Seekable), $pkg, qw(getpos setpos));
so the fact wanted is that IO::Seekable DEFINES getpos/setpos.  Core
IO::Seekable gets them from the XS IO module; PCL ships a pure-Perl shim and
the shim does not define them.

LAYER (CLAUDE.md 9a): module behaviour -- it belongs in the lib/ shim, never
in Pl/ or cl/.  Both are thin wrappers and perl's own IO::Seekable documents
them: getpos returns an opaque position token (tell), setpos seeks back to
one (seek POS, 0).

WHY IT MATTERS: IPC::Cmd is one of the 73 modules in the everyday battery
(#1994) and is the portable way to run a subprocess.  core FileHandle.pm is
`use`d by much more than IPC::Cmd, so anything that reaches FileHandle takes
this.

BAR: a lib/ shim change => full sweep + the companion io/ leg + guard rows in
an existing Pl/t io file (a getpos/setpos round trip on a temp file with perl
as the oracle).
subject: EVERYDAY: IPC::Cmd does not load -- IO::Seekable::getpos / setpos are missing from the IO shim (core FileHandle.pm line 60 exports them)
